identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase III Clinical Study of Rezvilutamide in Patients With Metastatic Hormone-Sensitive Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Open-Label, Positive-Controlled Phase III Study of Rezvilutamide Combined With Androgen Deprivation Therapy (ADT) Versus Enzalutamide Combined With ADT for Treating Low-volume Metastatic Hormone Sensitive Prostate Cancer (mHSPC)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aims to compare the efficacy and safety of rezvilutamide with enzalutamide in the treatment of patients with low-volume metastatic hormone sensitive prostate cancer.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA) undetectable rate based on central laboratory.
primaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the proportion of subjects with a total PSA level below 0.2 ng/mL in central laboratory testing within 6 months after randomization.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: PSA response rate based on local laboratory.
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the proportion of subjects who achieved a ≥50% or ≥90% reduction in PSA levels from baseline among those who had not initiated ADT treatment prior to randomization.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: PSA undetectable rate based on local laboratory.
secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the proportion of subjects with a total PSA level below 0.2 ng/mL in local laboratory within 6 months after randomization.

The percentage of subjects with measureable disease at baseline who achieved a complete or partial response in their soft tissue disease using the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) version 1.1 criteria and PCWG3.
Time from randomisation to radiologically confirmed progressive disease or death due to any cause.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to PSA progression based on local laboratory.
secondaryOutcomes.description: Time from randomisation to the first time of PSA progression according to the criterion of PCGW3.
Defined as the time from randomization to the first occurrence of castration-resistant event.
Defined as the time from randomization to death due to any cause.
An AE is any untoward medical occurrence in a participant that is temporally associated with the use of study treatment, whether or not considered related to the study treatment.

locations.facility: The First Medical Center of the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) General Hospital
